title: One Question Beat the Game Level Nobody Could Beat #shorts

cast.jay: a ten-year-old boy with spiky black hair, a bright orange hoodie, blue jeans and a small green backpack
cast.red: a tall guard in full shiny silver armor with a closed silver helmet that hides his face, a small bright RED feather plume on top of the helmet, holding a long spear
cast.blue: a tall guard in the exact same full shiny silver armor with a closed silver helmet that hides his face, a small bright BLUE feather plume on top of the helmet, holding a long spear

lines.text: What one question beat the game level that sent every player back to the start?
lines.label: ONE QUESTION
lines.headline: THE LEVEL NOBODY BEAT
lines.image: {jay} standing alone with clenched fists and a determined face in a torch-lit stone castle hall of a video game, facing two tall closed arched wooden doors side by side, magical glowing light, dramatic

lines.text: In Jay's new game, the final room had two doors and two guards.
lines.label: FINAL ROOM
lines.headline: TWO DOORS, TWO GUARDS
lines.image: wide view of a torch-lit stone castle hall with two tall closed arched wooden doors side by side on the back wall, {red} standing still in front of the left door, {blue} standing still in front of the right door, {jay} walking in from the front looking up at them in awe

lines.text: One door led to the treasure; the other dropped you back to level one.
lines.label: THE STAKES
lines.headline: TREASURE OR START OVER
lines.image: two tall arched wooden doors side by side in a stone castle wall, both wide open: through the left door a glowing golden treasure chest full of gold coins, through the right door a dark bottomless pit with nothing inside, {jay} standing small in the middle between the two doors looking from one to the other

lines.text: One guard always told the truth, and the other always lied.
lines.label: THE RULE
lines.headline: ONE TRUTHFUL, ONE LIAR
lines.image: {red} and {blue} standing stiffly side by side at attention in a torch-lit stone castle hall, two tall closed arched wooden doors behind them, the two guards look identical except for the plume colors, mysterious and serious

lines.text: Players got one question, and nobody knew which guard was which.
lines.label: THE PROBLEM
lines.headline: WHICH ONE LIES?
lines.image: {jay} scratching his head, puzzled, looking back and forth between {red} on the left and {blue} on the right, who stand perfectly still and silent in front of two tall closed arched wooden doors in a torch-lit castle hall

lines.text: Jay pointed at a guard and asked, "Which door would the other guard pick?"
lines.label: THE QUESTION
lines.headline: WHICH DOOR WOULD HE PICK?
lines.image: {jay} pointing confidently up at {red} and asking a question with his mouth open, {red} looking down at him, in a torch-lit stone castle hall beside a tall closed arched wooden door, determined mood

lines.text: Ask the liar: the honest guard would say treasure, so the liar says trap.
lines.label: IF THE LIAR
lines.headline: THE LIAR SAYS TRAP
lines.image: {red} alone, pointing his spear at a tall arched wooden door standing half open on the right that shows a dark bottomless pit behind it, his other hand behind his back with fingers crossed, sly sneaky pose, torch-lit stone castle hall

lines.text: Ask the honest guard, and he truthfully repeats the liar's answer: the trap door.
lines.label: IF THE HONEST
lines.headline: THE HONEST ONE SAYS TRAP
lines.image: {blue} alone, standing upright and calm with one open hand on his chest, pointing his spear at a tall arched wooden door standing half open on the right that shows a dark bottomless pit behind it, torch-lit stone castle hall

lines.text: Both answers point to the trap, so Jay walked through the other door.
lines.label: THE TWIST
lines.headline: TAKE THE OTHER DOOR
lines.image: {red} and {blue} both pointing their spears at the closed right-hand door of two tall arched wooden doors, while {jay} smiles and walks the other way through the open left-hand door, warm golden light pouring out of it, torch-lit stone castle hall

lines.text: The treasure chest burst open, and Jay was the first kid to beat the level.
lines.label: HE WINS
lines.headline: FIRST KID TO WIN
lines.image: {jay} cheering with both arms raised beside a big open wooden treasure chest overflowing with shining gold coins and jewels, sparkles and colorful confetti in the air, golden treasure room, triumphant and joyful
